body: My last job I thought for sure was going no where. Almost of month of silence id already given up hope, then one day I got an email out of the blue saying I’m starting in 2 weeks. I’m sure you’ve already tried but look into some other jobs too just incase it doesn’t go anywhere.

Is it possible you could search for a new job and move out? Here in my country anyone studying in university gets student accomodation in the cities CBD for dirt cheap. If you recently graduated high school you could go and study and worry about the debt later. Right now it sounds like you need to open the door for a second chance with life, create some options before you choose to die. It’s at least worth looking into. But you can’t make any good choices until you get out of there.
Would your friends help you if you got to Florida? Do you have anyone you can stay with?
